identified_by: MyGUI XML declaring widgets whose skins bind Morrowind's own menu_*.dds / tx_menubook*.dds texture names

REF-A12.identified_how: read directly; the file states what it is. No visual identification was required or possible.
REF-A12.pixel_metrics_note: Not an image. Every pixel statistic is null by construction. Must never enter a metrics population.
REF-A12.provenance_note: Byte-exact copy from a --depth 1 clone of https://github.com/OpenMW/openmw at f673ab858b8d. Not modified in any way.
REF-A12.slot_note: REF-A12 asks for the Morrowind UI (inventory, dialogue topic list, journal, map). No vanilla UI screenshot was obtainable - the sole Morrowind image source used by this corpus, dehero/mwscr, has the editorial rule "No interface". This slot is filled by UI STRUCTURE instead: exact widget geometry, skin construction, texture vocabulary and the colour table. It completely fills the layout half of the slot and does not fill the appearance half at all. See REF-A12/README.md.
REF-A12.vanilla_tests_note: The seven tests in the request's §7 are tests of a rendered screenshot. None of them applies to an XML layout file; recorded as null rather than as passes. What is testable here - that no third-party UI replacer is involved - is true by construction: this is the engine's own shipped resource set.

morrowind/REF-A12/config/mwui_constants..slot_note: REF-A12 asks for the Morrowind UI (inventory, dialogue topic list, journal, map). No vanilla UI screenshot was obtainable - the sole Morrowind image source used by this corpus, dehero/mwscr, has the editorial rule "No interface". This slot is filled by UI STRUCTURE instead: exact widget geometry, skin construction, texture vocabulary and the colour table. It completely fills the layout half of the slot and does not fill the appearance half at all. See REF-A12/README.md.
